title: riscv_size → ubuntu/jammy
diff:
diff --git a/debian/changelog b/debian/changelog
index 48009f6..9956064 100644
--- a/debian/changelog
+++ b/debian/changelog
@@ -1,3 +1,9 @@
+livecd-rootfs (2.765.46ubuntu1) UNRELEASED; urgency=medium
+
+  * riscv64: increase image size to 6 GiB (LP: #2077517)
+
+ -- Heinrich Schuchardt <heinrich.schuchardt@canonical.com>  Wed, 21 Aug 2024 08:47:21 +0000
+
 livecd-rootfs (2.765.46) jammy; urgency=medium
 
   * Add 6.8 kernel apparmor features' preseeds. (LP: #2074204)
diff --git a/live-build/ubuntu-cpc/hooks.d/base/disk-image-uefi.binary b/live-build/ubuntu-cpc/hooks.d/base/disk-image-uefi.binary
index 76e67ef..50545b1 100755
--- a/live-build/ubuntu-cpc/hooks.d/base/disk-image-uefi.binary
+++ b/live-build/ubuntu-cpc/hooks.d/base/disk-image-uefi.binary
@@ -33,7 +33,7 @@ fi
 fi
 
 if [ "$ARCH" = "riscv64" ]; then
-    IMAGE_SIZE=4831838208 # bump to 4.5G (4608*1024**2); initrd creation fails with "No space left" with 3.5G
+    IMAGE_SIZE=6442450944 # bump to 6 GiB (6*1024**3); initrd creation fails with "No space left" with 4.5 GiB
 fi
 
 . config/binary
